name: BENETEAU S.A. Actions Port. EO
summary: Beneteau S.A. is a French boat builder that designs, manufactures, and markets sailing yachts, motorboats, and other recreational boats. The company operates under several brands, including Beneteau, Jeanneau, and Lagoon. Beneteau is headquartered in Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie, France.
